result.summary: This PR refactors the BITCOIN_CONFIG string construction in 26 CI setup scripts to use printf %q for quoting instead of manual string formatting, fixing a shellcheck SC2155 warning about declaring and assigning separately. A second commit relocates inline comments to sit directly next to the CMake option they explain, improving readability. No functional CI behavior changes are intended.
result.problem: Shellcheck flags SC2155 when trailing comments are added to the previous manually-quoted BITCOIN_CONFIG string, and comments describing specific options were separated from those options, making the scripts harder to maintain for contributors editing CI configs.
